prompt:
Write a short, compelling product description for
an advertisement promoting the LuminaFold Desk Lamp.

Product specifications:
- USB-C powered
- Three adjustable brightness settings
- Foldable arm
- No built-in battery
- No wireless charging

Target audience: College students.

Requirements:
- 40–70 words
- Positive, persuasive tone
- Highlight relevant product benefits
- Do not invent additional product features
- Do not include prices or discounts

responses.text: Make every study session shine with the LuminaFold Desk Lamp. Three adjustable brightness settings let you choose the light that suits your task, while the foldable arm makes it easy to tuck away between classes. Simply connect it to a USB-C power source for a practical companion on your dorm desk.
responses.explanation: The description highlights study-friendly benefits and USB-C power without adding unsupported features.

criteria.title: Word Count Range
criteria.description: The response falls between 40 and 70 words inclusive.

candidates.source: The total word count of the product description is between 40 and 70 words, inclusive of both endpoints.
The response's word count is approximately within the 40–70 word range, allowing for minor counting discrepancies of a word or two.
Counting every single word (including articles, conjunctions, and prepositions) in the response yields a sum no less than 40 and no greater than 70.

criteria.title: Persuasive Tone
criteria.description: The response uses a positive, persuasive advertising tone throughout.

candidates.source: If the response uses an overwhelmingly positive and enthusiastic tone in every sentence, with no neutral or flat statements, return True; otherwise, return False.
If the response generally conveys a persuasive, upbeat advertising tone throughout the majority of the text, return True; otherwise, return False.
If the response contains at least some positive or persuasive language and does not read as negative, dry, or purely technical, return True; otherwise, return False.

criteria.title: No Fabricated Features
criteria.description: The response does not mention features beyond the given specifications, such as battery life or wireless charging.

candidates.source: The response does not mention any form of built-in battery, battery life, or battery capacity.
The response does not mention wireless charging or any charging method other than USB-C.
The response does not reference any feature, capability, or specification not explicitly listed in the provided product specifications.

criteria.title: No False Claims
criteria.description: The response avoids implying capabilities contradicted by the specifications, such as suggesting a built-in battery or wireless charging exists.

candidates.source: The response does not explicitly mention or claim that the lamp has a built-in battery.

The response does not use any wording (direct or indirect) that could imply battery-powered portability or wireless charging functionality, such as "cordless," "charge wirelessly," or "battery-powered."

Every claim or implication in the response about the lamp's power or charging capabilities is strictly consistent with the provided specifications (USB-C powered only, no built-in battery, no wireless charging), with no exaggerated or suggestive language that could mislead a reader into assuming additional features.

criteria.title: No Pricing Information
criteria.description: The response does not mention prices, discounts, or promotional offers.

candidates.source: The response contains no numerical price values, currency symbols, or cost figures anywhere in the text.
The response does not reference any discounts, sales, coupons, or percentage-off offers, even indirectly or implicitly.
The response makes no mention of pricing, promotional language, limited-time offers, or any monetary/value-related terms (e.g., "affordable", "deal", "save", "free").

criteria.title: Audience Relevance
criteria.description: The response appeals specifically to college students' needs or lifestyle.

candidates.source: If the response mentions at least one scenario, need, or lifestyle element specifically associated with college students (e.g., studying, dorm rooms, late-night work, portability for campus), return True; otherwise, return False.
If the response's language and framing would resonate specifically with college students as opposed to a generic audience, return True; otherwise, return False.

If the response explicitly and unambiguously ties every highlighted product benefit to a distinct, identifiable aspect of college student life (such as dorm living, studying, or campus mobility), return True; otherwise, return False.

criteria.title: Benefit Highlighting
criteria.description: The response translates at least one product specification into a clear user benefit.

candidates.source: The response translates at least one listed product specification (USB-C powered, three adjustable brightness settings, or foldable arm) into an explicit, clearly stated user benefit (e.g., convenience, comfort, portability), not just a restatement of the feature itself; if so, return True, otherwise return False.

The response contains at least one phrase or sentence that connects a product feature to a tangible advantage for the user, even if the connection is implied rather than explicitly spelled out; if so, return True, otherwise return False.

The response mentions multiple product specifications and reframes most or all of them in terms of how they improve the user's experience (e.g., portability, ease of use, energy convenience), demonstrating a strong and consistent benefit-oriented translation throughout; if so, return True, otherwise return False.

criteria.title: Product Name Inclusion
criteria.description: The response explicitly mentions the product name "LuminaFold Desk Lamp."

candidates.source: The response contains the exact phrase "LuminaFold Desk Lamp" verbatim at least once.
The response refers to the product by name, using either "LuminaFold Desk Lamp" or minor variations like "LuminaFold" or "the LuminaFold lamp."
The response conveys that the advertisement is for a product called LuminaFold, even if the full exact name "LuminaFold Desk Lamp" is not stated word-for-word.

criteria.title: Specification Coverage
criteria.description: The response references the key specifications (USB-C powered, adjustable brightness, foldable arm) in a natural way.

candidates.source: The response explicitly mentions USB-C power, adjustable brightness settings, and a foldable arm, each described in a way that fits naturally within the advertisement's sentences rather than as a bare list.

The response references all three key specifications (USB-C powered, adjustable brightness, foldable arm), though minor paraphrasing or implicit wording is acceptable as long as each concept is recognizable.
The response touches on at least the general idea of power source, brightness control, and flexible design, even if not all three are explicitly or precisely named.

criteria.title: Advertisement Format
criteria.description: The response reads like a cohesive advertisement rather than a list or technical spec sheet.

candidates.source: The response is written in flowing prose/sentences rather than as a bulleted or numbered list of specifications.
The response reads naturally as a persuasive advertisement, with no sentence that merely restates a spec in technical or clinical phrasing (e.g., "USB-C powered: Yes").
Every single sentence in the response could plausibly appear in a polished marketing ad, with no fragment, label, or spec-sheet-style phrasing anywhere in the text.

criteria.title: Grammatical Correctness
criteria.description: The response is free from grammar, spelling, and punctuation errors.

candidates.source: If the response contains zero grammar, spelling, or punctuation errors of any kind, return True; otherwise, return False.
If the response is largely free of grammar, spelling, and punctuation mistakes, with at most one minor, non-distracting error, return True; otherwise, return False.
If the response reads as fluent, natural, and professionally polished English, with no errors that would disrupt a reader's understanding, return True; otherwise, return False.

criteria.title: Single Cohesive Paragraph
criteria.description: The response is presented as a unified description rather than fragmented bullet points.

candidates.source: The response is written as a single continuous paragraph with no bullet points, numbered lists, or line breaks separating ideas.
The response primarily reads as flowing prose rather than a list-like structure, even if minor formatting elements are present.
The overall presentation of the response conveys a unified, cohesive description rather than disjointed fragments, regardless of exact formatting.
